image_description: A close-up shot of a human finger wearing a beige adhesive bandage (Band-Aid). The bandage features a central white pad with a colorful cartoon character print (resembling Disney characters). The background consists of blurred green grass and a white vertical structure, indicating an outdoor setting. The bandage conforms to the curvature of the finger.

The visible ends of the bandage show the characteristic rounded rectangular shape, although distorted by wrapping.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The central area with the print appears distinct from the side adhesive strips, consistent with a padded center.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The printed characters appear slightly soft and lack the crisp edge definition of real ink on fabric, showing minor 'smudging' into the fabric texture, though this could also be due to image compression or focus.

artifact_observations.location: Lower edge of bandage near finger crease
artifact_observations.reasoning: The bottom adhesive strip seems to merge slightly unnaturally with the skin tone at the crease, lacking a distinct shadow or edge separation, suggesting minor generation ambiguity in the contact area.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a Band Aid and not a generic patch or sticker, verifying specific visual features like the perforated texture.
To audit the boundary between the bandage and the finger/skin, ensuring there is no unnatural blending or floating edges, especially at the curved overlaps.
To analyze the quality of the printed character design, checking for AI-typical distortions in complex graphical elements like faces or text within the print.

focus_areas: Edge sharpness where bandage meets skin
Consistency of fabric texture across curved surfaces
Clarity and structural integrity of the printed cartoon characters
Lighting consistency on the cylindrical finger vs flat bandage
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the bandage and the finger. AI often struggles with objects wrapping around cylinders, leading to warped textures or impossible shadows. Verify if the cartoon print follows the curvature of the bandage logically or if it appears flat/pasted on. Check the lower adhesive strip for 'melting' into the skin.
